_about: THE PEONY (Paeonia lactiflora, the garden peony): huge full double blooms of crumpled rounded petals, pink, crimson or white, cupped round a ruffled heart; a leafy clump of stems with deeply cut dark leaves. Its LOOK, painted into the flowers' atlas (plants/flowers.js): petal / petal2 / centre / leaf / spike -- shape, colours (a list: one a variant), throat, veins and touches. How it GROWS -- stem, leaves, blooms and their sizes -- is its recipe in plants/flowers.js (GROW).
